scripts.typecheck: tsc -p projects/signal-request/tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit && tsc -p projects/signal-request/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && tsc -p projects/demo/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build:probes: ng build probe --configuration=none && ng build probe --configuration=request && ng build probe --configuration=keyed && ng build probe --configuration=full && ng build probe --configuration=devtools
scripts.attribution: pnpm run build && ng build probe --configuration=request --source-map --output-path=dist/probes/attribution && node scripts/bundle-attribution.mjs dist/probes/attribution/browser/main.js
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:demo && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:types-compat && pnpm run build:demo && pnpm run check:dist
